batting.name: AP Tare
batting.dismissal: c SK Warne b AD Mascarenhas

batting.name: SS Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c NV Ojha b SW Tait

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c P Dogra b A Uniyal

batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c Z Khan b AG Murtaza

balls.text: low full toss, hit down to mid-off ..
another low full toss, Harbhajan fails to connect with the big swing and is hit on the left pad in knee area ... Harbhajan limps across the single
goes for the yorker this time, dug out towards mid-off
slips it full and down the leg side... rubbish bowling, flicked away for yet another boundary
Thrashed away. It was the short delivery and McLaren plays a feisty pull shot.
goes for the yorker, ends up as a low full toss,. Harbhajan swings to the on side but edges it to his pad
slower one, full and well outside off, almost a wide but Harbhajan reaches out to hit it to long-off
stays back to drive powerfully to long-off and they run hard to come back for the second
change of pace of course, Harbhajan goes for the swing to the on side and drags his sweep to the square-leg boundary
full delivery outside off, pushed towards long-on

slower one outside off, Harbhajan can't connect but Sathish calls him over for a single ... Ojha underarms a direct hit and Sathish dives to get back inside the crease. But hold on .....he grounds the bat  inside the crease but  then it lifts in the air when the ball hits the stumps. Third umpire rules it out.
full delivery from round the stumps, lifted to long-off

Naman Ojha flies to his left to take a super catch. Tiwary's fine innings ends. He backed away to try swing this delivery to the on side but edged it behind, Ojha took off to pluck a smart one-handed catch
really full delivery, driven to mid-on
moves back inside the crease, goes for the big drive over covers but doesn't connect
banged in short and another ICL player, R Sathish, reaches out to carve it over backward point
low full toss, dipping on the batsman who drives it to Warne at short cover
Tait is fun to watch for the unpredictability! This one is a full toss way down the leg side
yorker length outside off, dug out to  backward point
tries to hit the slower one over midwicket boundary but finds the man at the deep ... Fine entertaining knock from Rayudu ends
walks down the track and swings the full toss away to deep midwicket region
picks the slower one and play a really skilful lofted hit to long-on boundary. He got the bottom-hand up and running there. 50 for Tiwary as well. Partnership is 109
goes for the yorker, just short of blockhole, pushed through midwicket
fullish outside off stump, pushed out to cover
from round the wicket, another slower one but wide outside off stump
The slower-one specialist arrives. Tapped to short third-man region
leans forward to flick it past square-leg
backs away to hit this one to left of long-off
hits this down to long-off
Thunderous Wallop! Rayudu, who used to play in ICL, is shining brightly here. He thrashes this one over midwicket. Good clean swing of the bat.
moves outside off stump, tries to paddle scoop it but misses and the ball bounces over middle stump
turns outside off stump, tapped to short third man
punches this one off the back foot to cover
Rayudu Gaaru is having loads of fun. Again, he rushed down the track and this time played a very fine lofted hit to left of long-on fielder
charges down the track and drags it to wide long-on boundary. Thump.
Rayuduuuuuu! Whaddaplayaaaaa! He moves down the track to play a loverly lofted hit over long-on.
gets this one down to long-on
Tiwary manufactures shots in style. He stayed back to pull the length delivery back over the bowler's head!
moves down the track and tries to swing it to the on side but doesn't connect .. the ball rolls off the pad
short delivery, quick, pulled away to deep midwicket
moves down the track and taps it to right of midwicket
Aaha! Rayudu plays a deft reverse paddle to pick up two runs
cuts this one to backward point for a single
Welcome Yusuf Pathan. Tiwary plays a flamboyant lofted hit over long-off. He just leaned forward - didn't move down the track - and lifted it up and over
gets forward to play a lofted shot to right of long-off
leans forward to work it to backward point
quicker, straighter, driven down the track
stays back, creates room to lift it over left of long-off .. nicely played
skips down the track and dabs it to midwicket
Thwack! Rayudu continues to indulge himself. He fetched it from outside off stump and slog swept it to wide midwicket boundary
plays the sweep shot to move the scorecard
Finally, a good delivery from Warne. He rips it across, on a length on the middle stump line, turns away, rayudu opens the bat-face to run it down with the turn to short third-man region
stays back to force it to long-off
Whack! Warne, as mentioned, has been just concentrating on pace variation and has been bowling pretty ordinary stuff so far. Tiwary rushes down the track and lofts this over long-on
charges down the track to loft it to right of sweeper cover. Fine hit.
outside off stump, gentle turn, nothing alarming, cut away to backward point
What a shot Rayudu Garu! He fetches it from the off and middle and plays a imperious-looking swing across the line to square-leg boundary.. He just swatted it away in style
on the leg stump line, turned behind square-leg
moves down the track and plays a nice lofted shot to left of long-off
length delivery outside off stump, mistimes the cut
length delivery on the middle and off, pushed to extra cover
length delivery on middle and leg, flicked away past square-leg
charges down the track to play a powerful drive past Warney
goes down on his knee to pick the ball from outside off and slog sweeps it over deep midwicket fielder who was ten metres inside the circle (Yusuf Pathan) and it climbs over him
quicker one well outside off stump, can't reach with the cut shot
leans forward to defend to the off side
pushes this one wide outside off stump
Tiwary reaches out to lift a flighted delivery to right of long-off
gets down the track to on drive to long-on
fullish, straight, driven back to the bowler
on drives it to long-on where Tait makes a mess of a regulation stop to give an extra run!
walks across the stumps and pulls a length delivery from middle and off line to deep midwicket
back of length, around middle and off line, slower one, pushed out to short cover
leans forward to drive to cover
full in length outside off stump, driven to long-off
on the middle stump line, lunges forward and flicks it across the line, against the turn to deep midwicket
flighted outside off, Tiwary chases it to drive to sweeper cover
tries to flick it away but will collect a leg bye
tosses it up ever so slowly, Rayudu moves down the track, takes it on the full and punches it via a firm flick to deep midwicket region where there is a fumble
full delivery outside off stump, flicks it to deep midwicket
tries to bowl him round the legs with a flighted delivery, the batsman goes for the sweep but it rolls off the pad
checks his on drive and the ball is in the air but lands safely much ahead of long-on fielder
leans forward to drive to mid-off
full delivery, Rayudu leans forward to play an airy flick - he does play that shot well - to midwicket boundary.
Two in three balls for Mascarenhas! What's happening out there? Gentle seam-up delivery around off stump but Tare drives it straight to Warne at short cover.
leans forward to drive through cover

Trapped right in front or was there a glove involved? Tendulkar goes for the paddle sweep shot but misses it completely. He is struck on the pad right in front of the middle stump. Pity, he didn't last long to face Shane Warne. Tendulkar throws his head back ... will see the replays to see whether it brushed the gloves before it hit the pad
gets forward to push the slower one to mid-on

Crunchy! Tare is making a good job of announcing his entry into the big league. It was slightly short in length and Tare, who played for Mumbai in the Ranji one-dayers this season, swivels to play a fine pull shot over midwicket.
picks this slower one early, waits and waits before playing a fine cover drive to pick up a boundary. how many is too many? Too many slower ones I think
from round the stumps, yet another slower one, on the middle and leg, turned down to fine-leg region
as expected he bowls a slower one, Tendulkar turns it past square-leg
Tendulkar waits for the length delivery to drift in middle and leg and plays the leg glance to fine-leg boundary
leans across to time the cover drive rather sweetly but hits straight to cover
Tare plays the short-arm jab pull to a delivery slightly short of length on middle and leg and connects well
bangs this one short, steered to backward point
And sprays this wide outside off stump. That's the danger with Tait.
gets this one straight and full, pushed out towards mid-off
And sprays this one full and wide outside off stump.
pushes this one down the leg side. Wide.
lovely off drive. It was full pitched just outside off and Tare creams it between mid-off and cover
in the zone outside off stump, tries to run it down to third man but doesn't connect
yet another slower one, on the middle and leg line, turned to square-leg
bangs it in short, pulled down to deep backward square-leg
full pitched on the middle and off line, edges the drive to wide mid-on region

Done in by the slower one. Amit Uniyal, who used to play in ICL, has trapped Jayasuriya right in front. Jayasuriya went for the swing across the line over midwicket but was too early into his shot and was hit on the pad. Dead plumb!

another slower one, again down the leg side, Tendulkar waits  -and he could have hit it anywhere -  opts for the sweep but doesn't connect properly .. the ball rolls to the left of the keeper .. cry of agony from Tendulkar
walks forward down the track and cover drives sweetly but can't pierce the field
starts off with a slower one but slips it wide down the leg side
goes for the pull but the ball wasn't all that short and didn't climb high enough .. the ball went below the flashing blade
tries the yorker, just short of blockhole, on middle and leg and Jayasuriya flicks it to short fine-leg fielder
length delivery outside off stump, cut away crisply to point. The outfield is really really fast
Wallop! Jayasuriyaaaaaaaaa! He leaned forward to smoke a full delivery over long-on. That bottom-hand, familiar to us for so many years, working over time to provide elevation and power.
full in length outside off stump, Tendulkar drives to right of cover where Asnodkar makes a diving stop. Both batsmen get together for a chat

Strange shot but he gets three. It was a gentle fullish delivery outside off, Jayasuriya pushed at it early, lunging out rather than moving forward but ended up chipping it just over the reach of the jumping cover fielder
cut firmly, but straight to the fielder at point
full ball outside off, Tendulkar opens the face and plays the square drive, Kamran Khan runs to his right on the boundary and dived full length to pull off a sliding save
Tait overcompensates for his straight lines by bowling wide outside off
and again, identical stroke, merely using Tait's pace to send the ball steadily towards the square leg boundary
short of a length and straight at 149.4 kmh, easy for Tendulkar who jumps back and across and flicks the ball with his wrists through square leg for four
the yorker at 145 kmh on off stump, Jayasuriya brings his bat down in time and squirts the ball past his leg stump
147 kmh but the ball is down leg side, Jayasuriya lets it go
length delivery down leg side, brushes the thigh pad as Jayasuriya misses the glance, the keeper dives to his right and then appeals for a catch
Jayasuriya keeps the strike by pushing the ball to mid on and calling Sachin for the single
too full and outside off, Jayasuriya launches it over cover with a mighty swing, three bounces and over the rope, Mascarenhas is feeding Jayasuriya his favourite deliveries
very wide again and Jayasuriya goes after it, this time he mis-times the shot to cover
full and straight this time, Jayasuriya punches and hits it crisply past the fielder at mid-on who dives to his left in vain
straighter ling this time, Jayasuriya gets an inside edge on the leg side
full and wide outside off stump, right up Sanath's alley, he throws his bat at it, carving the ball high over the infield and the ball runs to the cover boundary
Malinga clinches the win with a yorker ,,..Mascarenhas can't do much with it .. just a weak waft ... just a single ..
full, pacy, just outside off stump, driven to right of sweeper cover where Shikhar stops the ball but throws wide at the non-striker's end .. they complete the second run easily
Aaha! Just as I was singing his praise .. more fun .. he sprays it wide down the leg side .. 8 from 2 balls! Warne gets across for a chat.

What a bowler at the death .. another really full delivery, the batsman pushes it out towards long-on .. they try to get back for the second .they run really hard ,..  Sathish throws it to the striker's end but Mascarenhas just about manages to drag his bat inside the line.
yorker length, just short of blockhole, just outside leg, flicked away
Clatterrrrrrrr! Don't mess with Malinga! Full, straight, pacy,  Uniyal tries to swing at it and edges it on to his stumps

Dogra is run out Malingaaaaaaaaa! First he bowls a damn good yorker, then he rushes on to pick up the ball, which was dug out back down the pitch, and dives forward even as he flicks a direct hit at the striker's end
wonderful over.. again very full, straight, hit down to long-off. Warne seems very tensed .. he is pacing up and down beyound the boundary. Lasith Malinga to bowl
Fine delivery, almost at the blockhole , dug out to cover
It's not coming this ball. Fullish, it zooms past the stumps outside off and lands behind the wicket ... the batsman tries to free his arms but can't connect properly ...The keeper collects
backs away to slice the full delivery to deep cover. Just a run. Malinga will bowl the last over. He might be difficult to get away. Rajasthan need a boundary here in this over from Zak.
good in swinging full delivery, well played by Mascarenhas who clears the front foot and drives it straight past the bowler
length delivery outside off stump, lifted towards long-off. Just a single
aaha! more drama as Zaheer sprays this one wide outsdie off. 18 from 12. Who will cave in under pressure?
retains the strike with a drive to deep midwicket
poor stuff  from Sathish.. Under pressure, he has caved in as a bowler .. He slips this down the leg sdie and Dogra helps it along to the fine-leg boundary
short in length, from round the stumps this time and Dogra swings it to the midwicket boundary . What a charge this from Dogra ...
Crash! Dogra, who has been playing second fiddle so far, joins in the fun. Dogra wallops it high over long-on .. another length delivery, another in-the-slot ball
Dogra makes sure Rajasthan remain in the hunt. In the slot, on the length and he has swung it over long-off

Yusuf is run out! What a huge wicket! What a fine work from Sathish, the wonderful fielder! It was smashed back down the track, Sathish lunges to his right to stop it and has the presence of the mind to calmly flick a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Yusuf had backed up too far and couldn't come back in time. It has taken some fine fielding to terminate one of the most delightful T20 knocks.

thunderous wallop over long-on. This is the fastest hundred in IPL. Yusuf ... take a bow. Stunning innings. Great fun to watch. It was a full delivery and he clears the front foot to smoke it over long-on boundary.
full and outside off, Yusuf tries to drag it from there, across the line, but edges it to third man boundary
Bosh. The yorker ends up as a full toss and Yusuf swings it high over midwicket
drives to long-off
low fast full toss, swerves away from Yusuf who ends up slicing the attempted lofted shot well short of long-off
almost yorker, they will get just a single with a drive to long-off. Jayasuriya to Yusuf. This should be fun.
yorker length, dug out towards long-off. Just a single
backs away and hits the full toss to right of long-on where Tiwary makes a fine diving stop. The crowd loves the effort
good delivery, fuller, almost yorker length, driven to long-on
You go Yusuf! Immense fun for all of us. He thrashes this full delivery really hard and past the umpire ..and it crashes into the straight boundary

Run out chance missed and the umpire is involved it in it! Drama! good delivery, really full on the leg and middle line, whipped to Rayudu at deep midwicket ... confusion between the two batsmen .. both are almost at the striker's end. Rayudu's throw comes in .. the umpire moves across in line with the ball and the bowler is unsighted! What drama! The bowler doesn't collect the throw and Dogra escapes ... Tension ...
leans forward to drive to long-off. Yusuf back on strike. Here we go.
super yorker on the leg and middle line, dug out, just about, to midwicket
yorker on the middle stump line, pushed down to long-on for a single
yet another lifting delivery, unconvincing pull shot attempted but the ball goes off the edge back past the non-striker
bangs it short, pulled down to mid-on .. dot ball from Zak.
goes for the yorker outside off, driven down to long-off
low full toss, taps it towards long-off for a single

Top shot. He has smoked that. Malinga goes for the yorker but falls just short, enough for Yusuf, stationed well inside the crease, to get his bat under the ball and lift it dead straight over the bowler .. one bounce and over the rope
the slow bouncer, Yusuf doesn't pick it up at all, sort of checks his shot.. almost swats a catch to backward square-leg ..
full pitched outside off, square driven for a single
slower one, fullish, on driven to right of long-on. Two runs. Mumbai won't mind. Yusuf stays off strike.
full delivery on the middle stump, flicked straight to midwicket. Another dot ball. The crowd love it.
dot ball. Slower one, length delivery on off, tapped to the on side
full toss, punched to sweeper cover
Shout for lbw but it has been given as runs. Replays show no bat but perhaps it would have missed the leg stump anyway. It was a yorker, moved past the prod to hit the back pad
full again but well outside off, Yusuf tries to reach out with a yet another dab cum steer but doesn't connect. Wide given. Very harsh call.

Yusuf you beauty! Take a bow! Almost yorker length outside off stump and Yusuf just opens the bat-face and late cuts it through vacant slip cordon. A slip moves in now. Surprisingly, no bouncer, no short delivery yet.
More pressure. Wide down the leg side. What an innings this is turning out  to be.
You bowl full to him, he will keep hitting em. Low full toss around off stump, Yusuf square drives it to the boundary. Shane Warne chuckles in delight.

Fabulicious late steer to third man boundary. It was almost a yorker length delivery outside off, Yusuf just bends his back knee, crouches, opens the bat-face and guides it to third man boundary. Superbly played delicate shot.
full and well outside off, pushed out to extra cover for a single. Yusuf is back on strike
What loverly fun. Brother Yo is turning on the heat here. And in some style. A seemingly dead match is alive and kicking. This one has been swung away to deep backward square-leg boundary.
pressure. Wide down the leg side.

50 up from 21 balls! He swings this to high towards long-off .. McLaren jumps to catch the ball, lands with his feet just inside the line but then steps on the boundary .. he signals to the umpire that its a six
Whaddaplayaaaa! Immense fun. Low full toss, dipping on Yusuf who drills it over leaping Sathish
Smashed away. He picks this full delivery on leg and middle and swings it over to fine-leg boundary.
Massive! Yusuf Pathan is da Maan. He picks the full delivery and slices it over long-off.
leans forward to push the slower one to cover
More violence! Right in the slot and it has disappeared over long. That familiar clean full swing of the bat from Yusuf
Super hit. He leaned forward to play a powerful whippy flick over midwicket boundary.
Dropped by Sathish Very difficult chance. Yusuf had biffed a full toss to left of long-on where Sathish ran across and dived to his left but couldn't hold on ..it was always going away from him
really full delivery, jabbed back to the bowler
stays back to punch it to left of Murtaza who takes some pace off the ball with a half-stop
gets forward to drive it back to the bowler
low full toss  on the leg stump line, flicked straight to short fine-leg. Yusuf would feel he has missed out there
the slower bouncer arrives now ... swatted to the on side
the yorkers keep coming, this one has been squeezed out to backward square-leg
full delivery again, pushed past the bowler

The slow yorker takes him out. Timber! Jhunjhunwala is completely fooled by the change of pace. He has a waft across the line, a desparate attempt to get some bat on the ball, but misses and hears the death knell. Clatterrrrrrrr
yorker length on the middle and leg, tailed in late, wristed through midwicket
length delivery outside off stump, tries to chop it to third man but edges it behind the wicket .. bounces to the keeper
stays back to force the length delivery from outside off to long-on
lovely yorker outside off, goes under the bat and reaches the keeper
slower one , on a length on the middle, Yusuf checks his shot and pushes it down the track, the bowler makes a lunging stop
low dipping full toss around off, Yusuf wants to whip it across the line and edges it to his pad
Yusuf goes down town. Only he can win this game for Rajasthan. Full in length and he lifts it superbly straight down the ground
moves down the track, Murtaza shortens the length, punched down to long-on
works this one past square-leg
reaches forward and across to outside off, to unfurl a perfect square drive ..
Top shot. Thrilling. He sashayed down the track, stayed outside the line of the delivery and lifted it over wide long-off
really full delivery, driven down to long-on
leans forward to ping long-on
around the off stump line, worked away to long-on
length delivery on the middle, driven to long-on
Super catch from the ICL hero Sathish. It was a slower one on the length, Smith checks his shot and pushes out at it .. the ball flies low to the left of Sathish who takes a very good diving catch
length delivery on the stumps, lifted to long-on
full in length outside off, pushed to the on side
moves outside leg stump, Murtaza fires it really full, driven hard but straight to mid-on
fetches it from outside off and sweeps but its intercepted at backward square-leg
quicker one on the middle, tapped to the on side
on the off stump line, pushed out to mid-off
outside off stump, squeezed to backward point
Strikes first ball. The arm-ball on the middle stump line, Ojha tries to back away, create some room but is cramped by the armer and punches it straight to Zak at mid-off.
the fifth slower one of the over - run down to third man for a single
yet another slower one, Smith adjusts at the last minute to swat the short delivery past square-leg
yorker around the off stump, dug out to backward point
third slower one in a row, .. from a length, tapped to third man
the slower one again, full and outside off, Ojha is completely fooled ... has a waft at it and the ball loops past the bat
starts off with a slower one, mistimes the drive to right of mid-on where Shikhar stops and fires the throw at the non-striker's end
Thrashed. Fullish outside off and Ojha drills it through wide mid-off
charges down the track and outside leg, the bowler follows him and Smith edges the intended pull to midwicket
full delivery ,flicked away to deep backward square-leg region
on the middle and leg, clipped to deep square-leg
Fab hit. It was a length delivery outside off, Ojha stood still to play a fine on-the-up punchy drive through covers
back of length, homing in on the off stump, pulled away to mid-on
again on the length, driven to mid-off this time
Lash em Smith! Full length delivery on the off stump line and Smith whacks it over mid-off
Crunchy blow. Fullish and on the off stump line, Smith drives it past the non-striker ..
ooh how did that miss the middle stump? It was a length delivery bouncing in towards middle, Smith went for the swing across the line and missed it .. the bal climbed over the middle
Yet another edge. Full in length outside off stump, Smith goes for the off drive but ends up slicing it over backward point.
full length delivery around off, Smith wants to drive towards mid-on and gets another lucky edge to right of Malinga at third man
back of length, doesn't quite connect properly with the pull shot but will pick up a single
moves down the track for the lofted hit but gets a good thick inside edge to fine-leg boundary
stays back to wrist the full delivery from middle stump to deep square-leg
full delivery, on the middle, flicked to short midwicket
drags it short, pulled to Lasith Malinga at deep square-leg
length delivery around off stump, pushed out to cover
full delivery around off stump, tapped to cover
a lifting delivery, pacy and well-directed, Ojha hops to tuck it to the on side
full length delivery on the off, pushed to left of mid-off where Jayasuriya is stationed for a single
fab delivery, straightening outside off stump, Smith, who has always had the problems against Zaheer, is beaten, pushing inside the line

Swapnil is run out It went off the thigh pad to the off side ... confusion between the two .. Smith starts and stops. Swapnil tries to get back but Sathish rushes on from backward point, swoops on the ball and fires a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Gone!
really full delivery, pushed to mid-on.
